svg.title: Watt — detailed historical process explorer
svg.desc: Illustrative expert macOS interface showing linked CPU, memory and disk tracks, a sampled process parent tree with precise resource columns, and selected compiler identity and memory growth details. CPU uses core percentages. Memory footprint is separate from system pressure. Recording coverage is explicitly incomplete and compressed memory is unavailable.
svg.text: Design study · all measurements and identities illustrative
CPU: 100% = one logical CPU · averages and peaks over selected 90 sec · footprint at cursor · Δ and memory peak over selected interval
Rows show each process itself; parents do not include descendants. Click a column to sort siblings. Missing parents remain explicit.
Read, write and CPU time are interval deltas. Memory footprints are not additive; shared accounting can overlap.
arm64 · user process · still observed at cursor
Growth is observed; a leak is not established.
System memory pressure stayed normal during the selection.
5 sec process sampling · interval deltas use actual elapsed time
Parent links are observations, not a complete execution trace.
Processes that began and exited between polls may be missing.
12 process queries denied; resource coverage is incomplete.
A scan delay is not established. View supporting samples →
Sampled history · not every short-lived process is captured · “—” means unavailable, not zero
No synthetic memory impact score · system pressure remains a separate metric
An instrument for investigation: density, explicit units, observable process relationships, and evidence you can inspect.
Illustrative design · no installed security vendor implied
